items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 24 at 1:24AM EST until November 26 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 15 to 25
kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 5 to 8 ft expected. For the
Gale Warning, northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40
kt and seas 6 to 11 ft expected.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 6 AM this morning to
8 PM EST this evening. For the Gale Warning, from 8 PM this
evening to 1 AM EST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
